My Stable

A living stable of inherited body plans. Breed for horns, claws, armour, wings and body shape, then test the results in competition.
Stable limit: 6 monsters. Sell a monster you no longer need to make room for new bloodlines.
💡 Breeder's tip: All four special genes are rare recessive traits with the same 1.2% new-carrier odds per gene. Two copies express the gene; combining two, three or all four gives escalating combat bonuses and distinct portrait palettes. A named +1/+2/+3 birth mutation occurs in 25% of births. Breeding is limited by its 1,000-gold cost and the six-monster stable limit.

🧬 Breeding Lab

Choose two available parents. Alleles for horns, claws, armour, fangs, wings, body plan and colour pass into the offspring. Those inherited features alter both appearance and combat performance.

How Genetics Work

⚔️ Power
Damage dealt and physical force.
🛡️ Defence
Reduces incoming damage.
💨 Speed
Improves initiative and dodge chance.
❤️ Vitality
Determines maximum health.
🎯 Technique
Improves accuracy and critical hits.

Genes are not destiny: offspring stats are based on the parents' average, with random variation and occasional mutations. A champion is made over generations.

🏆 The Five-Division League

Each division has 20 monsters and plays a 19-bout round robin. League wins pay 10–50 gold depending on division; losses earn no gold. Each bout adds an independent -9 to +9 form roll to both combat ratings, so close underdogs can upset favourites. The top three in Champions, Division 3, Division 4 and Division 5 normally move up one tier; promotion into Premier requires an actual special-gene carrier or an expressed gene; a mutation-only Rare does not qualify. The Premier champion may qualify for Europe. The bottom three move down wherever a lower division exists. Light-blue rows identify your stable. Green rows mark promotion places, with a bright green line below 3rd place; a strong red line marks the start of the bottom-three relegation zone. In Premier, a green line above 2nd place separates the league winner, who qualifies for Europe. AI genetic rarities: Division 5/4 all Common; Division 3 half Common and Uncommon; Champions half Uncommon and Rare; Premier all Rare. Europe opponents are Epic (one expressed gene); World opponents are Epic with two or three expressed genes.

🛒 Monster Market

Four fixed offers: Common has no mutations or special genes; Uncommon has one standard mutation; Rare has two standard mutations and no special genes; Premium guarantees one special-gene carrier allele but never an expressed gene. Each offer is balanced against its matching league strength. Buying one immediately replaces only that offer.

🧾 Recent transactions

Prize rules: League podium prizes are Division 5: 100/50/25g; Division 4: 200/100/50g; Division 3: 400/200/100g; Champions: 800/400/200g; Premier: 2,000/1,000/500g. European Champion receives 10,000g; World Champion receives 25,000g. These title and placement prizes are on top of existing bout-win rewards. League bout wins pay by division: Division 5 +10g, Division 4 +20g, Division 3 +30g, Champions +40g and Premier +50g. European wins pay +100g per bout; World Championship wins pay +200g per bout. Losses and Legends Arena exhibitions pay 0 gold. Breeding costs 1,000g; Training Manual costs 500g. Market offers are Common (no mutations), Uncommon (one standard mutation), Rare (two standard mutations and no special genes), and Premium (one guaranteed special-gene carrier, never expressed). Buying an offer replenishes that same tier. No daily stipend or breeding cooldown.

🎨 Gene Art Studio

Explore ten base creature types across seven visual tiers, alongside the four live recessive genes and their hybrid forms. Special-gene palettes are applied to each monster’s own species portrait, so a Mythic Wolf remains a wolf rather than becoming a dragon.

All artwork is embedded in this HTML file, and the game remains playable offline. New recessive genes, named birth mutations, escalating hybrid bonuses and championship entry requirements are active in gameplay.
